title: 第四章 芍药 · 下
content_zh:
我若不是芍药，那么你说我是谁。晚媚起身，闭着眼一步步摸索到韩修跟前。
韩修垂头，挣扎着告诫自己这不是场梦就是场阴谋。
跟前晚媚叹气：或者这个女子和我际遇相象，我才能回来上得她身。可是韩郎你为什么害怕，我其实从来没怨过你。
这句话使韩修霍然抬头，眸里最后的冷静开始动摇。
每个人都有弱点，都会有段不堪面对的过去。
他的弱点就是芍药，当时一流妓院的清倌，蒙面抚琴为生，日日听客无数。
如果当日那批私盐倒卖成功，他就能兑现诺言，救她脱离苦海。
可惜的是他被人出卖，交易时被官兵团团围住，来了个人脏并获。
贩卖私盐是死罪，在他以为自己必死无疑时有人突然
他当时欣喜若狂，第一时间跑去告诉芍药，结果见到的却是芍药的尸身，仍有余温的尸身。
她以自己清白和性命，换了他的自由和日后的如锦前程。
这是他的罪孽，就算骨化成灰也没法洗刷的罪孽，他从没原谅过自己。
可是我觉得你应该怨我。回想到这里他的理智又退让三分，开始觉得眼前这人就是芍药：我根本就不配叫做男人。
晚媚这时抬起了手，微弹指甲抖出一点白粉，乘势送进了韩修口鼻。
白粉是失魂散，迷人心智的。如果是在平时，这点小伎俩在韩修跟前根本没有机会施展，就是得逞了，这点药量也绝对控制不了他。
可现在不一样，眼前这一出旧日重现已经让他摇摇欲坠，这一点失魂散，足够成为压跨松枝的最后一粒雪。
我不怨你。做完动作之后晚媚张开双臂：只是回来瞧瞧你过得可好。
韩修怔怔，残存的理智最后崩溃，缓缓将身子放低，脸靠进晚媚胸膛，贴住了那朵芍药。
我娶了你姐姐，把该给你的好都给了她。在她胸前他低声，象个无助的孩子。
晚媚点头：我姐姐不能生育身子又不好，多谢你这么多年照应她。

那个顾御史我栽赃他勾结私盐商贩，七年前死在牢里了。
晚媚又点头，下巴埋进他发顶：所以我不怨你，死时不怨，现在更是不怨。
韩修沉默，在她胸前微微颤抖。
可是我不能原谅自己。他最终叹息：不管你是不是芍药，我都愿意跟你走，愿意接受惩罚，受你百倍之苦。
晚媚这时笑了，拿出那支发簪，有些讥诮的意思：这么说你愿意被戳瞎双眼？受我百倍之苦，到头来其实不过是空话一句。
韩修不语，只是抬起头，缓缓睁开双眼。
晚媚咬牙，簪尖一记刺去，他右眼顿时血流如注。
果然是顺从没有反抗，甚至连一句痛呼都没有，晚媚吃惊，握住发簪的手禁不住有些颤抖。
计划中是两人见面后温存，在他不能自制时杀了他。
可现在看来是不必了，眼前的韩修已经完全没有抵抗意识，一百个甘心为芍药一死。
晚媚有些手软，可最终还是把长簪送进了他左眼窝，使了力一下送到底。
韩修的身子应声萎靡，头重重滑过晚媚胸膛，在那朵芍药上留下一行血泪。
晚媚弯下腰去，看他表情是无嗔无喜，一派解脱模样，不知道为什么有些失神。
房间角落里的红魔伞开始有动静，地涌金莲闻到死人气息，开始舒展花瓣跃跃欲试。
晚媚回身，不知是出于什么样的心思，草草披起件衣服，抓起伞从窗口一跃而下。
外头夜色沉沉，她回望身后，不知怎的心里触底一酸。
小三一向以轻功自诩，可身后这位轻功显然也是不弱，两人一路追逐到片树林，小三一直没能把他甩脱。
于是他干脆止步，在月下霍然回身，手里握住了破魂剑。
韩玥倒是没想到他居然不逃了，脚下收势不住，于是干脆也拔剑前冲。
剑还没曾近身，寒气却已经迫在眉睫，小三不敢轻敌，使上了八成功力。

两把剑于是在夜下交锋，韩玥那把到底是普通铁剑，虽然剑气凛冽，可还是被破魂剑轻易削成了两截。
这结果出乎韩玥意料，忙乱之中他只好出掌，想借掌风劈开小三的剑势。
那一刻小三看见了他胸口的破绽，知道只要破魂剑剑芒再涨数寸，他就可以轻易夺了眼前这人的性命。
可是最后关头他却收势，迎上韩玥掌风，身子后退吐了口血。
你不如回去看看你大哥如何了。在韩玥拔足追来时他说了这句，接着衣衫临风飘摇而去。
韩玥吃惊，回味了他这句话之后才大梦初醒，转身拼了命往回。
一切当然是已经太迟，在那香粉阁二楼，他最终看见的是大哥还未凉透的尸身。
抱住那尸身他仰天长啸，想要把心肝脾肺一起吼碎。
在这样的绝望里他却反而清醒了，眼前掠过那绿衣女子的眉眼，一双清冽中浸着媚惑的凤眼。
我一定曾经见过她，一定！这句话在他心里盘旋，最终被他咬牙切齿一字字吐出。
※※※※
晚媚趴在床上，小三很仔细的在她伤口上药，听着她不断抽气。
小三于是抱怨：我早说过鞭痕也可以做假，你偏偏要来真的。要知道你是靠身子吃饭的人，万一留下疤痕可就糟了。
瞎眼是假的，下身的血是假的，如果鞭痕也是假的，那么破绽也未免的太大。晚媚回道：你当韩修真是傻子吗，他可是习武又从商，精明的很。
小三点头：无论如何主子你这个套下的很好，严丝合缝。
晚媚在他示意下翻身，由他处理前胸的伤口，想了想又道：其实这个套不如那个消息重要，你能不能告诉我，你到底从哪里得来的资料，把韩修的底细摸的一清二楚。
门里还有个组织叫做鬼眼。小三慢条斯理回她：专门负责打探消息和监视门里的杀手，消息我就是从他们那里得来。他们是什么都知道，包括你胳肢窝里有几根毛。
监视杀手？晚媚闻言嗓子低了下去：你的意思是这里有人监视我们。
小三点头：鬼魅的眼睛是无处不在，你这么低声说话也未必有用。
说话间他的手指已经来到晚媚右乳，在那朵带血芍药上流连，想把它擦了。

晚媚捉住了他手，扣住他五指按上那朵芍药。
你相不相信，韩修是真爱芍药，心甘情愿的要随她去。她看住他，双眼间有水波荡漾：这世上原来还真有白如芍药的爱情。
小三垂头，挣扎着想把手抽出，急急跟了句：我觉得主子这句感慨没有任何意义。
我知道没有意义。晚媚追住他不肯罢休：我只是想问你，如果真有那么一天，你也爱上我，你会不会也愿意为我放弃性命。
小三终于抬头看了她一眼，一眼万年，之后急急逃脱。
在鬼门里面，影子是决计不可以和主人有纠缠的。那个我会爱上你的假设根本不成立，所以这个问题我不需要回答。他低声道：我去打些水来，替主子把这朵芍药擦了。
晚媚闻言冷笑了声，心想他果然是怕死，那种酸涩的异样滋味一下又涌了上来。
外头这时有人敲门，有把声音如夜般鬼魅冰凉，道：公子有请晚媚姑娘。
content_en:
If I am not Shaoyao, then who do you think I am? Wan Mei stood up and walked step by step to Han Xiu with her eyes closed.
Han Xiu lowered his head and struggled to tell himself that this was either a dream or a conspiracy.
Wanmei sighed before me: Maybe this woman and I have similar circumstances, so I can come back and get her. But Han Lang, why are you afraid? In fact, I have never complained about you.
These words made Han Xiu suddenly look up, and the last calmness in his eyes began to waver.
Everyone has weaknesses and a past that is difficult to face.
His weakness is Shaoyao. At that time, he was a waiter in a first-class brothel. He made a living playing the piano while wearing a mask, and listened to countless customers every day.
If the batch of private salt was successfully resold that day, he could fulfill his promise and save her from suffering.
It's a pity that he was betrayed and was surrounded by officers and soldiers during the transaction.
Selling illegal salt is a capital crime. Just when he thought he was certain to die, someone suddenly
He was so happy at the time that he ran to tell Shaoyao immediately, but what he saw was Shaoyao's body, which was still warm.
She exchanged her innocence and life for his freedom and a bright future.
This was his sin, a sin that could not be washed away even if his bones were turned into ashes. He had never forgiven himself.
But I think you should blame me. Thinking back to this point, his rationality gave way again, and he began to feel that the person in front of him was Shaoyao: I don't deserve to be called a man at all.
Wan Mei raised her hand at this time, flicked her nails slightly to shake out a little white powder, and took advantage of the situation to send it into Han Xiu's mouth and nose.
White powder is lost and charming. If it were normal times, this little trick would have no chance to be used in front of Han Xiu. Even if it succeeded, this little amount of medicine would never be able to control him.
But it was different now. The reappearance of the old days in front of him had already made him shaken. This loss of consciousness was enough to become the last grain of snow that pressed across the pine branches.
I don't blame you. After finishing the action, Wan Mei opened her arms: I just came back to see how you are doing.
Han Xiu was stunned, and his remaining sanity finally collapsed. He slowly lowered his body, leaned his face into Wan Mei's chest, and pressed against the peony flower.
I married your sister and gave her all the good things that should be given to you. He whispered against her chest like a helpless child.
Wan Mei nodded: My sister is infertile and in poor health. Thank you for taking care of her all these years.
That Gu Yushi died in prison seven years ago after I framed him for colluding with private salt traders.
Wan Mei nodded again, burying her chin into the top of his hair: So I don’t blame you, not when I died, and even more so now.
Han Xiu was silent, trembling slightly on her chest.
But I can't forgive myself. He finally sighed: No matter you are a peony or not, I am willing to go with you, willing to accept punishment and suffer a hundred times as much as you.
Wan Mei smiled at this time, took out the hairpin, and said sarcastically: So you are willing to be blinded? I suffered a hundred times more, but in the end it was just empty words.
Han Xiu said nothing, just raised his head and slowly opened his eyes.
Wan Mei gritted her teeth and stabbed the tip of the hairpin, causing blood to flow from his right eye.
As expected, he obeyed without resisting, not even a cry of pain. Wan Mei was surprised, and the hand holding the hairpin couldn't help but tremble.
The plan was to be gentle after the two met, and then kill him when he couldn't control himself.
But now it seems that it is no longer necessary. Han Xiu in front of him has no sense of resistance at all, and he is willing to die for Shaoyao.
Wan Mei was a little soft-hearted, but finally she put the long hairpin into his left eye socket and pushed it all the way to the end.
Han Xiu's body slumped in response, and his head slid heavily across Wan Mei's chest, leaving a line of blood and tears on the peony.
Wan Mei bent down and saw that his expression was neither angry nor happy, but he looked relieved. She didn't know why he was a little absent-minded.
The red magic umbrella in the corner of the room began to move, and the golden lotus smelling the breath of the dead began to spread its petals eagerly.
Wan Mei turned around, and for some unknown reason, she threw on some clothes hastily, grabbed an umbrella and jumped out of the window.
outsideThe night was dark, and she looked back behind her, feeling sour in her heart for some reason.
Xiao San has always prided himself on his Qing Gong, but the man behind him was obviously not weak in Qing Gong. The two chased him all the way into the woods, but Xiao San was still unable to get rid of him.
So he simply stopped and suddenly turned around under the moonlight, holding the Soul-Breaking Sword in his hand.
Han Yue didn't expect that he would stop running away and couldn't hold his feet back, so he simply drew his sword and charged forward.
The sword hadn't even gotten close, but the cold air was already imminent. Xiao San didn't dare to underestimate the enemy, so he used eight power.
The two swords clashed in the night. Han Yue's sword was an ordinary iron sword after all. Although the sword was fierce, it was easily cut into two pieces by the Soul-Breaking Sword.
This result was beyond Han Yue's expectation. In the panic, he had no choice but to use his palm to split Xiao San's sword force.
At that moment, Xiao San saw the flaw in his chest and knew that as long as the Soul-Breaking Sword's sword glow increased a few inches, he could easily take the life of the man in front of him.
But at the last moment, he stopped his momentum, faced the wind of Han Yue's palm, stepped back and vomited blood.
You might as well go back and see how your brother is doing. He said this when Han Yue rushed to catch up, and then left with his clothes swaying in the wind.
Han Yue was surprised. After thinking about his words, she woke up from her dream, turned around and went back with all her strength.
Of course, it was already too late. On the second floor of Xiangfen Pavilion, what he finally saw was his elder brother's body that had not yet cooled down.
Holding the corpse, he looked up to the sky and roared, wanting to break his heart, liver, spleen and lungs into pieces.
In such despair, he became sober. The woman in green's eyes flashed before his eyes, a pair of clear and charming phoenix eyes.
I must have seen her before, definitely! This sentence swirled in his mind, and he finally said it word by word through gritted teeth.
※※※※
Wan Mei lay on the bed, and the mistress carefully applied medicine to her wound, listening to her gasping for breath.
The mistress then complained: I have told you that whip marks can be faked, but you want to make them real. You must know that you are a person who relies on your body to make a living. It would be terrible if you leave scars.
The blindness is fake, the blood on the lower body is fake, and if the whip marks are also fake, then the flaws are too big. Wan Mei replied: Do you think Han Xiu is really a fool? He is a martial artist and a businessman, so he is very shrewd.
The mistress nodded: No matter what, master, you did a good job with this condom, it fits perfectly.
Wan Mei turned over at his signal and let him treat the wound on her chest. She thought about it and said: Actually, this condom is not as important as the news. Can you tell me where you got the information to know Han Xiu's details clearly.
There is also an organization in the door called Ghost Eye. The mistress replied to her slowly: She is responsible for inquiring about information and monitoring the killers in the door. I got the information from them. They know everything, including how many hairs you have in your armpits.
Surveillance for a killer? Wan Mei lowered her voice when she heard this: "You mean there is someone watching us here."
The mistress nodded: Ghost eyes are everywhere, and it may not be useful if you speak so quietly.
While he was talking, his fingers had already reached Wan Mei's right breast, lingering on the bloody peony, trying to wipe it off.
Wan Mei grabbed his hand, held his fingers and pressed on the peony.
Do you believe it or not, Han Xiu really loves Shaoyao and is willing to let her go. She looked at him, with water rippling between her eyes: It turns out that there really is love as white as peony in this world.
The mistress lowered her head, struggled to take her hand out, and said hastily: I think the master's emotion is meaningless.
I know there's no point. Wan Mei pursued him and refused to give up: I just want to ask you, if one day you fall in love with me, will you be willing to give up your life for me.
Xiao San finally raised his head and glanced at her for a thousand years, then hurriedly escaped.
In the ghost gate, the shadow is determined not to have any entanglement with its master. The assumption that I will fall in love with you is simply not true, so I don’t need to answer this question. He whispered: I will fetch some water and help the masterThis peony is rubbed.
Wan Mei sneered when she heard this, thinking that he was really afraid of death, and that strange and sour taste suddenly came back to her.
There was a knock on the door at this moment, and a voice as cold as a ghost in the night said: "Young master, please invite Miss Wan Mei."
